## Routes: the handler behind each one

A problem report's trace names its route (`route` in the bugs tool's get); find it here. key: needs X-Key; none: open; token: the connector's address.

- `GET /api/bugs` src/worker/debug/bugs.js (listRoute) [key]
- `POST /api/bugs` src/worker/debug/bugs.js (report) [key]
- `GET /api/bugs/:id` src/worker/debug/bugs.js (getRoute) [key]
- `POST /api/bugs/:id/close` src/worker/debug/bugs.js (closeRoute) [key]
- `GET /api/bugs/:id/shot` src/worker/debug/bugs.js (shotRoute) [key]
- `GET /api/health` src/worker/api/account.js (health) [none]
- `GET /api/me` src/worker/api/account.js (me) [key]
- `GET /api/projects` src/worker/api/projects.js (list) [key]
- `POST /api/projects` src/worker/api/projects.js (create) [key]
- `GET /api/projects/:id` src/worker/api/projects.js (get) [key]
- `GET /api/projects/:id/changes` src/worker/api/changes.js (poll) [key]
- `POST /api/projects/:id/changes` src/worker/api/changes.js (post) [key]
- `GET /api/projects/:id/export/:file` src/worker/api/projects.js (exportDxf) [key]
- `POST /api/projects/:id/undo` src/worker/api/changes.js (undo) [key]
- `GET /api/selfcheck` src/worker/api/selfcheck.js (selfcheck) [key]
- `GET /api/settings` src/worker/api/account.js (getSettings) [key]
- `PUT /api/settings` src/worker/api/account.js (putSettings) [key]
- `POST /mcp/:token` src/worker/mcp/server.js (handleMcp) [token]
- `GET /tiles/naip/:z/:x/:y` src/worker/api/tiles.js (tile) [none]
